title: Nvidia senior manager linked to Supermicro scheme smuggling AI servers to China
summary: Taiwan has indicted nine people— reportedly including an Nvidia senior manager and two Supermicro employees based in the country—who allegedly helped forge documents to cover up illegal exports of high-end AI servers to China in violation of US export controls.
